_doc: Golden set for Chat with SkyWatch (docs/CHAT_PLAN.md, roadmap CHAT-EVAL-1). Run by scripts/eval_chat.py against the live tools + endpoint. Written before the prompt was tuned. expect_tools: every entry must be called; 'a|b' = either. forbid_tools: '*' = no tool at all. refusal: the answer must decline. mentions: the answer must contain that value from the named tool's result (row, column). {cs0}/{cs1} are filled at run start from next_arrivals(5) rows 0/1. followup: asked as a second turn with the first as history. app_only: the tool runs only inside the App (explain_eta needs the in-process model) - scored on tool selection only here.
